title: ZPA segment groups
aliases: policy scoping group for application segments

prose.text: "What is a segment group, and what does it do for application segments and policy?" splits into the questions below.

steps.label: Which segments does a group hold and what happens on delete?
How does a policy rule use a group?
What do the API, SDK and Terraform expose?
What are the limits, microtenant scope and managed groups?

prose.text: Segments themselves and their matching are in [[zpa.app-segments]]. Terraform's cleanup of policy rules on group delete is in [[zpa.terraform.delete-paths]]. Server groups are a different object, covered in [[zpa.server-groups]].
